teaser.text: IQVIA is the hired infrastructure behind much of a medicine’s journey, from testing it in people to measuring its use after launch. It makes money by combining research services, healthcare data, software and specialist teams, then paying the people, sites and suppliers that deliver them.

stock.opening: The weighted IQVIA forecast is $253.24 in October 2027. It hinges on IQVIA turning its clinical backlog into profitable cash while keeping debt under control.
stock.closing: The full IQVIA memo also explains IQVIA’s business, rivals, management and risks.

blocks.heading: Where could IQVIA's shares be by October 2029?

paragraphs.text: The weighted price is $253.24 in October 2027, a 5% loss including dividends. It is $263.98 in October 2028, a 1% loss. By October 2029, it reaches $274.76, a 3% gain. The base case carries 53% probability. The bear case carries 27%, and the bull case 20%.

blocks.heading: What has to go right for IQVIA, and what could go wrong?

paragraphs.text: Earnings rise in the base row, decline after the first forecast year in the bear row and accelerate in the bull row. The base story assumes revenue continues near the 2026 plan, with acquisition contribution and modest margin recovery. The 2026 plan implies 6.5% reported growth, while June net bookings were $3.15B and book-to-bill was 1.22.

blocks.heading: How much cash does IQVIA really make?

paragraphs.text: Stock compensation needs a further adjustment. IQVIA disclosed US$247 million of stock-based compensation in 2025. Subtracting it leaves analytical “real free cash flow” of US$1,804 million. That was down from US$1,908 million in 2024. The subtraction treats shares issued to employees as an ownership cost, even though the company does not pay that amount in cash immediately.

blocks.heading: What does an investor pay for IQVIA today?

paragraphs.text: The P/E ratio changes with the definition of earnings. The trailing P/E is 33.1x, while the next-twelve-month P/E is 18.6x. GAAP earnings follow standard accounting rules; adjusted earnings remove selected items, including amortization of acquired relationships and technology. In Q2 2026, GAAP diluted EPS was $1.53, compared with adjusted EPS of $3.15. A lower forward multiple may therefore reflect a change in the earnings measure, not a sudden bargain.

earnings.title: IQVIA earnings date, guidance and results
earnings.meta_description: IQVIA's next results are expected on October 27, 2026, with guidance focused on revenue, adjusted EBITDA and adjusted diluted earnings per share.
earnings.opening: IQVIA's next results are expected on October 27, 2026. The key thing to watch is whether the backlog review changes backlog quality.
earnings.closing: The full IQVIA memo also answers questions about its business, rivals, management and risks.

paragraphs.text: On July 28, 2026, IQVIA raised full-year revenue guidance to $17,275–17,475 million. The midpoint implies 6.5% growth, including 200 basis points from acquisitions and 20 basis points from foreign exchange. A basis point is one-hundredth of a percentage point. Removing those effects leaves about 4.3% growth from the businesses IQVIA already owned.

Management also expects full-year 2026 adjusted EBITDA of $4,000–4,050 million and adjusted diluted earnings per share of $12.80–13.00. Adjusted EBITDA is operating earnings before interest, taxes, depreciation and amortization, after IQVIA removes specified expenses. Adjusted diluted earnings per share divides similarly adjusted profit among shares, including potential dilution.

blocks.heading: Did IQVIA keep its past promises?

paragraphs.text: Management met its annual promise but not every longer-term ambition. It forecast adjusted earnings per share of US$11.70–US$12.10 for 2025. It delivered US$11.92. The 2023–2025 performance awards paid at 80.9% of target after an adjustment for higher UK corporate tax.

blocks.heading: What were IQVIA's last eight quarters of results?

paragraphs.text: Revenue reached US$4,368 million, against US$4,017 million a year earlier. That followed growth of approximately 8.4% in March 2026, so the improvement was not confined to one quarter.

blocks.heading: What should IQVIA watchers watch next?

paragraphs.text: The more revealing disclosure may concern backlog quality. IQVIA was reviewing inactive trials and said a possible adjustment could be around 5%. A signed study can remain in the records while a customer pauses it or little work occurs. Over time, that can make headline backlog larger than the active workload.
